name: figure-skill
description: Evidence-aware scientific figures with managed PaperBanana and AutoFigure backends, provenance, and QA.

interface.shortDescription: Generate, edit, trace, and QA scientific figures.
interface.longDescription: Turn research text, experiment data, and existing figures into vector, raster, or source-audited hybrid outputs, with managed PaperBanana and AutoFigure wrapper Skills and isolated runtimes.
defaultPrompt: Create an editable scientific figure from my research inputs.
Turn my experiment data into a provenance-tracked plot.
Review and repair this figure without inventing evidence.
